SELECT sru.id AS flagId,sui.uid AS userId,sui.user_name,sui.real_name,sui.mobile ,sui.user_state FROM sys_role_user sru JOIN sys_user_info sui ON sru.user_id=sui.uid AND sui.is_deleted = false WHERE sru.role_id=#{params.flagId} AND sru.is_deleted = false
sui.user_name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') OR sui.real_name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%')
